page.content:
Fattiest cut of tuna belly, a luxury neta of the modern counter.

How Otoro connects

  • Item: Nigiri — Otoro is a luxury tuna neta served as nigiri.
  • Location: Tsukiji Market — Tsukiji's tuna auctions made otoro a public luxury.

What is Otoro?

Otoro is the melt of bluefin belly that Tsukiji and Toyosu auctions made famous, a prestige topping of postwar and overseas omakase.

Key threads lead to Nigiri and Tsukiji Market.
